Batch 4 — independent review

25 reviewed: 23 candidates with limitations; Malta fidelity hold and Rwanda archive-byte hold. No final art approvals or art changes.

50 fresh offline desktop/mobile cases and 25 shared motion suites passed. 1,344 internal archive members verified; Rwanda selected HTML differs only in newlines but remains an exact-byte failure. No fresh Blender/collision/fallback verification.
